title: incident-bot: weight auto-diagnostics by on‑call priority signals
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: during high-noise incidents the incident-bot's automated diagnostic suggestions surface too many low-value runbooks. This PR applies priority weighting to auto-diagnostics by incorporating on-call signals (pager frequency, service impact tag, recent ownership activity) to rank suggested runbooks and actionable diagnostics. Changes include a new priority scoring pipeline, unit + integration tests, telemetry for ranking decisions, and a rollout flag to gradually enable weighting. Checklist: - [x] design doc (ENG-2432) - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests (flaky test isolated) - [x] telemetry + dashboard - [x] feature flag gated rollout - [x] docs updated (oncall runbooks guide).
